messages:
maya: Heads-up — starting prod rollout for release/rl-3.2 in ~10 minutes (slice A -> slice B). Canary will be 5% -> 25% -> 100%. @ryan please be on rollback standby. I'll monitor user-facing KPIs for 30m after full roll.
ishaan: Got it. I'll watch latency dashboards and tail the serving logs. Running the mini smoke-suite after canary completes.
deploy-bot: [deploy started] release/rl-3.2 -> prod (slice A). Canary target: 5% (10 instances). CID: cb-2945200001. See: https://console.redwood.ai/deploys/cb-2945200001
olivia: Running quick functional checks against public endpoints once canary is stable. Plan:
- /v1/generate smoke (5 prompts)
- embeddings sanity (3 vectors)
- health ping to /health
I'll paste curl snippets when ready.
ryan: Rollback plan ready. If needed:
```
# quick rollback
./scripts/rollback_prod.sh --deployment rl-serving --revision previous
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/rl-serving
```
I have branch r/1234 with the hotfix and the 1-click rollback script staged.
maya: Canary (5%) looks green after 6m: p50=58ms p95=210ms errors=0.02% :thumbsup: advancing to 25% in 3m. Will flag if p95 > 400ms or errors >0.5%.
ishaan: Noticed a small tail on CPU for long-seq requests (sequence>2k) during canary. Adjusting batch_limit from 16 -> 8 for slice A to reduce latency spike:
```
# runtime config patch
PATCH /v1/config/slice-A
{"batch_limit":8}
```
olivia: Kicked off the functional smoke set after the 25% step. Results: 20/20 generation checks passed. Embeddings: 2/3 within expected latency, one at 1.2s (filed INF-789). Filtered logs show no internal errors.
deploy-bot: Canary progressed: 25% -> 50% -> 100% (complete). All health checks OK. Metrics snapshot: p50=62ms p95=240ms error_rate=0.03%.
maya: Rolling to 100%. We'll watch the dashboards for 30m. Triggering automatic rollback if p95 > 400ms, error_rate > 0.5%, or throughput drops >15%.
ryan: If we need an immediate rollback, also run:
```
# force traffic off new revision
kubectl set env deployment/rl-router TRAFFIC_WEIGHT=0
```
and notify oncall @SRE.
olivia: Quick note: after rollout I will run the extended probe (100 prompts across regions) and post results here. If anything else surfaces I'll open a follow-up ticket.
ishaan: Watching logs and traces. I'll DM if I see any alerting noise that looks like regressions.
maya: Great work team — keeping this thread as the canonical handoff. Post-roll checklist (I'll tick off here):
- [x] Canary 5% confirmed
- [x] Config tweak applied for long seqs
- [x] Functional smoke 20/20
- [x] Embedding perf ticket INF-789 created
- [x] Rollback scripts staged
- [x] 30m watch started
:party-parrot:
